alternatives.name: Stovetop whole-wheat mac & cheese with broccoli & peas (meal 'dinner-wholewheat-mac-cheese-broccoli')
alternatives.why: Same dish, about 15 minutes on one pot, made from whole-grain pasta, milk and real cheese instead of an ultra-processed mix. Cooked whole-wheat pasta has about twice the fiber of enriched pasta (FDC 3.9 vs 1.8 g/100 g), and the vegetables bring the meal to about 13 g fiber (FDC-computed). Cheese is still a moderation food in a Mediterranean pattern and this meal has about 11 g saturated fat, so it is a step away from the box, not an eat-freely dinner.
alternatives.lookFor: Pasta: 'whole wheat' or 'whole durum wheat' as the FIRST ingredient (or the 100% Whole Grain Stamp). Cheese: a block of real cheddar or parmesan (ingredients: milk, cultures, salt, enzymes, maybe annatto) instead of 'cheese product', 'cheese sauce mix' or powdered whey. On the Nutrition Facts label, 5% DV or less of sodium/added sugars per serving is low and 20% DV or more is high (FDA).

alternatives.name: Better boxed mac & cheese (store-bought step)
alternatives.why: If you want to keep the box for convenience, the same type can be a better step: whole-grain pasta and a real-cheese sauce. On Open Food Facts the powdered-sauce Kraft boxes are NOVA 4, but Kraft Deluxe with a real cheese sauce pouch (barcode 0021000658862) is NOVA 3. That is still processed and salty, so it is an in-between step, not the goal.
alternatives.lookFor: Whole grain as the first pasta ingredient; the sauce made from cheese (e.g. 'cheddar cheese (milk, cultures, salt, enzymes)'), not mostly whey, milk protein concentrate or sodium phosphates; a short ingredient list; sodium 20% DV or less per prepared serving. Stir in frozen peas or broccoli to add vegetables. On the Nutrition Facts label, 5% DV or less of sodium/added sugars per serving is low and 20% DV or more is high (FDA).
